title: Mesoscopic learning dynamics of extensive-width neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.23779v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding how stochastic gradient descent learns internal representations in wide neural networks trained on rich target functions is a central problem in machine learning. We study this question in two-layer neural networks learning target functions represented by networks of the same architecture, with arbitrary nonlinearity, and with network width and input dimension growing proportionally. In this regime, standard approaches for describing the learning dynamics require tracking a diverging number of overlaps, which measure correlations between learned and target features, leaving no obvious description in terms of a few order parameters. Here, we develop a mesoscopic description of learning by characterizing the distribution of overlaps. In the early stages of learning, we find that a Gaussian description of overlap statistics reduces the learning dynamics to a few collective variables that track learning of the target function

translated_title: 广宽度神经网络的介观学习动力学
translated_abstract: 理解随机梯度下降如何在宽神经网络中学习内部表示（这些网络在丰富的目标函数上进行训练）是机器学习中的一个核心问题。我们在两层神经网络中研究这一问题，其中目标函数由具有相同架构的网络表示，非线性形式任意，且网络宽度与输入维度成比例增长。在这种情形下，描述学习动力学的标准方法需要追踪数量发散的重叠量（overlap），这些重叠量衡量了学习到的特征与目标特征之间的相关性，因此无法用少数几个序参量给出明确的描述。在本文中，我们通过刻画重叠量的分布，发展了一种学习的介观描述方法。在学习早期阶段，我们发现重叠统计量的高斯描述能够将学习动力学约化为少数几个集体变量，这些变量追踪着目标函数的学习过程。
tldr: 该论文通过刻画重叠量的分布，提出了一种介观描述方法，将广宽度两层神经网络学习任意非线性目标函数的动力学约化为少数集体变量的演化，从而克服了传统方法需要追踪发散数量序参量的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a mesoscopic description of learning dynamics in extensive-width two-layer neural networks by characterizing the distribution of overlaps, reducing the dynamics to a few collective variables and circumventing the need to track a diverging number of order parameters.
